title: Hippo vs Nile Crocodile — Who Wins?
description: A male hippo against a Nile crocodile. Nat Geo says male hippos weigh up to 9,920 pounds and reach 16.5 feet; Africa's largest crocodilian reaches about 20 feet and up to 1,650 pounds. Hippo canines can reach 20 inches. Nat Geo lists small hippos among Nile crocodile prey. These sources list a higher maximum weight for hippos; that is not evidence of who would win a real fight. Hypothetical matchup.
